findings.note: Oct 23, 2026: Cirelli was cleared to play Oct 23 vs. Colorado after leaving the Oct 20 game with an undisclosed injury, averaging 17:00 TOI over his first nine games; nothing found on his status after Oct 23 or for tonight vs. Winnipeg.
Last season he had 121 shots in 68 games, about 1.8 per game, as a top-six center who plays in all situations. That rate means he often gets 2+ shots, which works against the Under 1.5.

Oct 21, 2026: He did not play the third period of the Oct 20 win over Vegas because of an undisclosed issue and was listed day-to-day. If the injury lingers, his ice time or the risk of another early exit could favor the Under.
